answer: Go to Settings > Security > Reset password, or click "Forgot password" on the login page. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.
Invoices are emailed on the 1st of each month and are available under Account > Billing > Invoices. You can add a VAT number there too.
We offer full refunds within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, refunds are pro-rated and require approval from the billing team.
Orders ship within 2 business days. EU delivery takes 3-5 days, US 5-8 days. A tracking link is emailed once the order ships.
You can upgrade or downgrade anytime under Account > Plan. Upgrades apply immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.
API docs are at docs.example.com/api. API keys are under Settings > Developers. Webhook retries happen 3 times over 1 hour.
